name: Marari Beach (CGH Earth)
summary: Marari Beach is a CGH Earth resort on a 30-acre coconut grove at Mararikulam, beside a working fishing village. Its palm-thatched cottages follow local fisherfolk homes, and it has a four-acre organic farm.
highlights: 30 acres of coconut grove, lily ponds and fruit trees
Four-acre organic farm worked with local farmers
Cottages re-thatched each year by women from the neighbouring fishing village
Run by CGH Earth, a Kerala hotel group
